fileName.description: Relative to this JSON file ("./source/rock.png", optimized into src/public/aek-assets/), or a URL path served from src/public ("/textures/rock.png", optionally after `path`).

slot.description: A standalone texture's slot (default: default). A GLB's textures are classified by their material slot.

textures.description: Per-slot overrides, or false to keep the textures as they are.

codec.description: uastc: 1 B/px on every device (BC7 / ASTC 4×4), the default. etc1s: smallest download, colour slots only. none: not encoded (exact data, CPU readback).

maxSize.description: Largest side in px, downscaled to fit (null: the source size).

mipmaps.description: Write the full mip chain (default true).

rdo.description: UASTC only: RDO lambda (0: off). 2 for colour, 1 for normal / ORM / data.

zstd.description: UASTC only: Zstandard supercompression level (0: off).

normalMode.description: Two-channel normal map (X in RGB, Y in A). Needs a material that unpacks it.

vramMB.description: Estimated GPU memory of the whole asset in MB: its textures (KTX2 at 1 B/px, the most it takes on any device) plus a GLB's geometry (null: no limit).

downloadMB.description: The output file's size in MB (null: no limit).

budget.description: Per-asset limits. Set in an asset JSON's own optimize, it also replaces the per-texture ceiling (each texture's VRAM must fit its slot's maxSize and codec as set without the asset JSON's overrides).

optimize.description: Asset optimization (p300): a profile, the slot and per-slot overrides, or false to keep the file as it is.

size.description: Width and height the channels are combined at (default: the sources' size, which must then agree). The optimize step resizes the result to its maxSize.

anyOf.description: A constant (0..1, linear) in every channel of the target.

src.description: A source image relative to this JSON ("./source/ao.png"), or a URL path served from src/public. 8 or 16 bits.

channel.description: The channels of `src`, one per target channel (default: the target's own, eg. "rgb"). A greyscale image has its grey in r, g and b.

colorSpace.description: How `src` is encoded (alpha is always linear). Default: srgb for the colour channels of an sRGB texture (texOpts.colorSpace), else linear.

normal.description: `src` is a normal map: it is resized as unit vectors, before its channels are taken. Only `invert` applies.

remap.description: Maps [min, max] to 0..1; auto: the full range of the channels taken.

invert.description: 1 − value, after remap (eg. a DirectX normal's G).

src.description: A source image relative to this JSON ("./source/ao.png"), or a URL path served from src/public. 8 or 16 bits.

strength.description: value × (1 + (factor − 1) × strength), eg. 0.8 for AO into albedo (default 1).

multiply.description: Multiplied in after remap and invert (linear values), eg. AO into the albedo.
